note: Fingerprints are the first 15 bytes of the SHA-512 of the PKIX SPKI DER, raw base64. A private key reports the fingerprint of its public half, so a key and its pair agree. Files holding several keys report one line each, in file order.

cases.name: Fingerprint Multiple ED25519 Keys
cases.note: ed25519_3 holds both key 1 and key 2, so it reports two lines.

cQBQY+x1KQrCLDeTOkrN ed25519_1_key.pem
cQBQY+x1KQrCLDeTOkrN ed25519_1_pub.pem
